name: Pico Display
tagline: A compact starting point for your embedded interface.
summary: Integrate a display module into your own enclosure and build the interface with Brilliant Display Editor.
audience: Embedded developers and equipment designers integrating a display into their own product.
highlights: Compact display formats for custom equipment
facts: Choose a screen size and confirm the target board configuration
note: Looking for a 5-inch or 7-inch configuration? Contact us with your resolution and interface requirements. CPU, memory and available I/O depend on the selected board.

name: Infinite Display
tagline: A display platform for larger embedded interfaces.
summary: An STM32H750-based display family with 5-, 7- and 8-inch screen formats.
audience: Equipment developers selecting a display for an embedded operator interface.
note: Contact us to confirm panel availability and size options for 800 × 600 and 1024 × 600. The 4.6-inch 華凌 panel (800 × 320) was used previously.

name: Aeternus Display
tagline: Connect your interface to the world around it.
summary: An enclosed HMI family combining a touch display with peripheral connections and Python-based application development.
audience: Equipment builders looking for an enclosed interface with direct peripheral connectivity.
highlights: PWM, analog input and I²C connectivity
Ethernet, Wi-Fi and industrial communication options
facts: PWM with capture, 10-bit analog input, I²C
note: Interface availability, resolution and enclosure configuration must be confirmed for the selected model. Contact us about other screen sizes and application requirements.
